release_notes:
A small update.

Refreshed trial reminders, with clearer pricing and a reminder of the 30-day money-back guarantee.

If you're trying PC AutoPilot, the day-7 reminder can now send you tips by email for the rest of your trial. Nothing is sent unless you type your address and tick the box, the app itself doesn't keep a copy, and you can unsubscribe any time.

Small fixes to the Duplicate Finder and Cleanup progress windows.
